diagnosis: The telemetry inspection route queries a global in-memory cache populated by a custom OpenTelemetry SpanProcessor. When provided with a spanId, it immediately serializes the span's in-flight attributes without verifying if the span was generated on behalf of the requesting client. Attackers who obtain active span IDs from response headers (e.g. W3C traceparent headers) can inspect internal microservice parameters and cache attributes.
